description: Fetch full Art Institute of Chicago records for up to 10 artworks by id: description, provenance, exhibition and publication history, dimensions, inscriptions, credit line, categorization, gallery, image URLs with rights status, and related multimedia. Long histories are opt-in through sections. Ids come from artic_search_artworks, artic_search_exhibitions, or artic_search_artists.

ids.description: Artwork ids, 1 to 10, as an array or a comma-separated string; https://www.artic.edu/artworks/<id> page URLs are read as their id. Duplicates are dropped.

include_related_media.description: Load related multimedia (lectures, audio stops) for the records, up to 20 items per call.

sections.description: Heavy text sections to include: description (also short_description), provenance, exhibition_history, publication_history, catalogue. Defaults to description and provenance; pass an empty array for none.

name: artic_get_artworks

artworks.description: Records in request order; ids the museum does not have are left out.

alt_images.description: Alternate images (other views, details); same rights as the primary image.

iiif_info_url.description: IIIF info.json URL for the image.

alt_titles.description: Other titles the work is known by.

artist_display.description: Artist, nationality, and life dates as the museum displays them.

artist_id.description: Id of the preferred credited artist; pass as artist_id to artic_search_artworks.

artist_ids.description: Ids of every credited artist; pass one as artist_id to artic_search_artworks.

artwork_type.description: Artwork type, such as Painting or Print.

catalogue.description: Catalogue raisonne entries; returned with the catalogue section.

credit_line.description: Credit line naming how the museum acquired the work.

date_display.description: Date as the museum displays it; the authority when the years are absent.

date_end.description: Latest year of the date span, negative for BCE; omitted when absent or implausible.

date_qualifier.description: What the date marks, such as Made or Printed.

date_start.description: Earliest year of the date span, negative for BCE; omitted when absent or implausible.

description.description: Curatorial description, CC BY 4.0: credit the Art Institute of Chicago and cite web_url. Present when the description section was requested and the museum wrote one.

edition.description: Edition statement for prints and multiples.

exhibition_history.description: Exhibitions the work has appeared in; returned with the exhibition_history section.

gallery.description: Gallery where the work is on view, such as Gallery 240.

image.description: Primary image with constructed IIIF URLs and its reuse status; absent when the work has no image.

alt_text.description: Alt text the museum wrote for the image.

iiif_info_url.description: IIIF info.json URL listing the image dimensions, sizes, and tiles.

rights.description: Reuse status: public_domain images are CC0; in_copyright images need a rights check before reuse.

url.description: IIIF image 843 px wide, the museum display size; available for every image, public domain or not.

url_large.description: IIIF image 1686 px wide; present only for public-domain works.

inscriptions.description: Inscriptions, signatures, and marks as catalogued.

is_on_view.description: True when the work is on view at the museum now.

is_public_domain.description: True when the work is public domain, so its images are CC0.

main_reference_number.description: Museum reference (accession) number; empty when the museum lists none.

manifest_url.description: IIIF Presentation manifest URL; present for public-domain works.

on_loan.description: Loan statement when the work is on loan.

provenance.description: Ownership history; returned with the provenance section.

publication_history.description: Publications citing the work; returned with the publication_history section.

related_media.description: Related multimedia (lectures, audio stops) from the museum; present when requested and at least one linked item loaded, never an empty list.

title.description: Asset title; empty when the museum lists none.

short_description.description: Short curatorial description, attributed like description; returned with the description section.

title.description: Title as catalogued; empty when the museum lists none.

web_url.description: Public page for the artwork on artic.edu.

deferred_ids.description: Found ids left out because the response budget was reached; request them in a follow-up call.

description_attribution.description: Attribution owed for description text (CC BY 4.0); present when any is returned.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: The Art Institute API throttled this server and retries ran out, or the shared request queue could not start the call in time. `request_blocked`: The Art Institute API's firewall blocked the request, as it does for markup or script-like text and for bursts of traffic. `upstream_rejected_query`: The Art Institute API rejected a request this server built from valid inputs. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

license_text.description: License statement from the API for this data, verbatim.

missing_ids.description: Requested ids with no artwork, in request order.

notice.description: Guidance when ids are missing or deferred, or related media was capped or could not load.

title: Get artworks
